SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, scope_rank
FROM (
  SELECT pairs.*,
         avg_feerate - AVG(avg_feerate) OVER () AS excess,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY acctscope
           ORDER BY avg_feerate - AVG(avg_feerate) OVER () DESC
         ) AS scope_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
    FROM fees AS f
    JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
    JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
    GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
  ) AS pairs
)
WHERE excess > 0 AND scope_rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, scope_rank
